notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
List of fixed bugs
- Sometimes passengers do not board at the bus stop
- Some sections that do not result in "out" even if the bus completely strays off the road
- Some bus stops in winter stage were pushed to the bus and unable to pick up passengers

Changes
- The bus speed increases proportionally according to the speed of moving the cursor in the mouse area.
- When you press the brake, the higher the speed the more it slides without stopping immediately.
